dct_description_sm: Funding for this project was provided by the Partnered in Teaching and Learning grants program.

We conducted a survey of McMaster undergraduate students in Fall 2025 about the costs of textbooks and other course materials and students’ experiences with purchasing or not purchasing textbooks and other course materials. The data have been anonymized to remove any identifying information. The anonymized raw data is available in MTAS_RawData_anonymized.csv. The anonymized raw data, with tabs analyzing responses to the different survey questions, is available in MTAS_RawAndProcessedData_anonymized.xlsx.
